about_the_game:
Enter a world where evolution is power and creativity is survival. Mutagenic 2 is an action RPG that lets you design your own path through limitless customization, brutal combat, and endless replayability.

Shape your character from the ground up with a massive passive tree offering thousands of potential builds. Combine and refine your abilities through a vast library of active skills, supports, and unique variations— each capable of transforming how you fight. From elemental juggernauts to agile casters, every build is a unique expression of your imagination.

Battle through dynamic encounters that test both your reflexes and your ingenuity. Discover rare loot to unlock new forms of power, craft devastating gear, and push your creation beyond its limits.

Then, climb the global leaderboards to prove your mastery. The most efficient builds, the boldest experiments, and the fastest clears all earn their place among the Mutagenic elite.
